description: Image Description: The image features an old computer mouse with a wooden casing, characterized by a rectangular, curved shape. It has a single red button on the top right corner. Next to it, there is a dome-shaped object, likely a part of the same device, connected by a cable. There is also a coiled, braided cable in the foreground, which is attached to the mouse. The lighting gives the scene a warm tone, and the entire setup is placed on a flat surface.
